parsed.explanation: The quote appears verbatim and is correctly read: it announces a goal ('Need to show'), not a proof. Checking the entire text, no universal Xiang reply is ever constructed: after conjecturing c=(n+1)/(2n+1), each attempted idea (completing the equal grid, mirroring, threshold/threshold-counting bounds) is explicitly abandoned ('So previous plan fails... So need different Xiang strategy to upper bound'), and the file ends with an unexecuted computational brute-force plan. Nothing proves that for every Liu division Xiang can hold Liu to any fixed constant for all n; moreover the targeted constant (n+1)/(2n+1) is not even the correct 2^n/(2^(n+1)-1). The upper-bound obligation (U) is therefore wholly unmet, and the gap is load-bearing for the claimed value.
